scope: Explicit FanAndLighting receipt reapply with paired per-actor runtime revision and instance protection. Internal actor API only; no public group transfer IPC/CLI/GUI yet.

contract.revision: State and revision returned together by each sole actor. Pair includes independent random instance IDs and generations. New user mutation admissions (including invalid/HID-failed attempts) and successful group installs advance generation; sensor refresh and reads do not. Fresh actor lifetime prevents ABA even when numeric generations repeat.
contract.admission: Both freeze ACKs before checking expected runtime revision; current settings-owner receipt must exist, be FanAndLighting and selected_content_current. Direct/Clear ephemeral overrides are protected even if durable group hash is unchanged. Saved group/slot edits invalidate receipt even with fresh actor token.
contract.apply: Construct group from current owner readback; preflight both, seal runtime reconciliation, both silent installs, both Apply responses, release on known result. No CommitProfileGroup, settings deltas, new receipt or profile revision. Existing global alerts retained. Unknown durable/partial-runtime barrier cannot be bypassed with reapply.
contract.lost_reply: Accepted operation continues after caller reply drop. Install advances revisions, so retry with old token fails before output. Client must read current state after ambiguous reply. Receipt read/import duplicate alone never applies again.
contract.restart: Fresh actors can reapply a current durable receipt using fresh runtime snapshot. Fixture uses actual store/new settings owner/new cooling and RGB actors; this is not a production DeviceManager sleep/detach or hardware test.

regression.coverage: Actual codec/store/settings owner/cooling/RGB actors, private fake HID only. Recover known write errors at65/73 with same device.toml/profiles.json bytes and one receipt/revision; completed operation invalidates old token. Direct Fan blue changes runtime token while durable hash/bytes unchanged; stale request leaves Direct intact; explicit fresh snapshot restores imported red. Saved manual42/green rejects both stale runtime token and current token against superseded receipt. Lost reapply reply finishes exactly one additional4-write Apply; old retry emits nothing. Fresh actors reapply current durable settings and reject pre-restart token after matching local install counts. Missing/wrong Screen receipt emits nothing and rejection resumes ordinary setters.

checks.hardware: NOT RUN: user explicitly deferred; only private queues/temp stores

remaining: Public group transfer IPC/CLI/GUI, readback/reapply controls, progress/cancel and Windows archive mapping
Extended partial install/reconciliation, production DeviceManager sleep/detach/restart and contended/cancel/fault qualification
Legacy unset versus explicit manual PWM0 and remaining basic parity roadmap/checklist
